required_documents.name: SF-424 Application for Federal Assistance
required_documents.details: Standard application form submitted electronically via FEMA GO by the State applicant.

required_documents.name: Grants.gov Lobbying Form (Certification Regarding Lobbying)
required_documents.details: Required federal certification regarding lobbying activities for applications over $100,000.

required_documents.name: SF-424C Budget Information (Construction) or SF-424A (Non-Construction)
required_documents.details: Budget information form integrated in FEMA GO detailing federal and non-federal cost share allocations.

required_documents.name: SF-424D Standard Assurances (Construction) or SF-424B (Non-Construction)
required_documents.details: Standard federal assurances submitted electronically through FEMA GO.

required_documents.name: SF-LLL Disclosure of Lobbying Activities
required_documents.details: Required if any funds have been paid or will be paid to any person for influencing federal officials.

required_documents.name: FEMA GO Subapplication and Scopes of Work
required_documents.details: Complete subapplication in FEMA GO detailing mitigation scope of work, technical specifications, and project milestones.

required_documents.name: Benefit-Cost Analysis (BCA) Toolkit Calculation
required_documents.details: Completed FEMA BCA toolkit export demonstrating a Benefit-Cost Ratio (BCR) of 1.0 or greater (or qualifying pre-calculated benefits).

required_documents.name: NFIP Policy Verification Documentation
required_documents.details: Documentation certifying active National Flood Insurance Program policy in effect for each assisted structure prior to application opening.

required_documents.name: Non-Federal Cost Share Commitment Documentation
required_documents.details: Official commitment letter or council resolution verifying source, availability, and amount of the 25% non-federal matching funds.

required_documents.name: Environmental Planning and Historic Preservation (EHP) Documentation
required_documents.details: Site photos, floodplain maps, environmental review materials, and historic property clearances required under NEPA and NHPA.

required_documents.name: FEMA GO and SAM.gov System Registrations
required_documents.details: Active SAM.gov registration with UEI, active Grants.gov account, and authorized FEMA GO user access.

deadlines.what: FEMA GO Final Application Due Date

eligibility.summary: State governments, territories, and federally recognized tribes are eligible applicants. In North Carolina, the primary applicant is the State of North Carolina (NC Emergency Management / NC DPS). Local governments, cities, and counties apply as subapplicants through NCEM and must participate in the NFIP in good standing.

cost_share.details: Standard 75% federal / 25% non-federal cost share. Up to 90% federal cost share for repetitive loss properties, and up to 100% federal cost share for severe repetitive loss properties.

review_criteria.criterion: Threshold Review Criteria (NFIP policy, BCR >= 1.0, Hazard Mitigation Plan)
Reduction of Risk to NFIP (Severe Repetitive Loss and Repetitive Loss claims)

submission_limits: Applicants may submit an unlimited number of subapplications. Each subapplication may not exceed $25 million in federal cost share.
important_notes: All structures included in an acquisition or elevation project must have an active NFIP policy in effect before the opening of the application period.
Subapplications must have an approved local hazard mitigation plan and demonstrate cost-effectiveness via FEMA BCA toolkit (BCR >= 1.0).
Applications must be submitted through FEMA GO; Grants.gov is not used for submission.
